alias: Whole House: the HomePod starts at 40%
description: Each time Music Assistant's Whole House group (Kitchen Echo + HomePod) starts playing from idle or off, the HomePod is set to 40%. During the session the Show's volume buttons move it in proportion (whole_house_show_buttons_volume), so without this it began wherever the last session left it. A pause and resume is not a new start. Ty, 2026-11-04: the HomePod sounded quieter at 30%.

conditions.value_template: {{ trigger.from_state is not none and trigger.from_state.state not in ['playing', 'paused', 'buffering'] }}
